owner_requirements_satisfied.2_original_parquet_bytes: 36 files staged for seasons 2017-2025, 2.91 MB. Byte-for-byte copies; the copy step asserted equality of both size and SHA-256 against the source before the file was accepted.
owner_requirements_satisfied.3_paths_bytes_hashes: every staged file carries its upstream relative_path, byte count and SHA-256 in the staging manifest
owner_requirements_satisfied.4_separate_family_labels: staged under data/wnba/source/staging/ESPN/** and data/wnba/source/staging/WNBA_OFFICIAL/**; the two trees are never merged
owner_requirements_satisfied.5_no_normalization: NOTHING was parsed, rewritten, renamed, re-encoded or schema-changed inside the staging copy. All analysis below reads the staged bytes without modifying them.

coverage_as_acquired.correction_to_a_first_reading: The bare directory listing suggests the official family has no box scores before 2026, and that reading is WRONG. The official family's wnba_stats/schedules/*.parquet is misnamed: it is not a schedule. It carries 40 columns including min, fgm, fga, oreb, dreb, tov, pts, plus_minus, player_id and player_name, mixed at two grains distinguished by the measure_type column — measure_type IS NULL gives TEAM-game rows, measure_type = 'p' gives PLAYER-game rows with minutes. For 2024: 5,438 rows = 524 team rows (262 games x 2) + 4,914 player rows. Official team box AND player minutes for 2017-2025 are therefore present, inside a file whose name does not say so.
coverage_as_acquired.consequence: Both the official-plus-one finality rule and the minutes reconciliation are achievable for 2017-2025. Neither is blocked.

cross_family_reconciliation.method: Independent check run on the staged bytes. ESPN team_box team_score versus WNBA_OFFICIAL team-grain rows (measure_type IS NULL) aggregated per game. Match key is DATE + BOTH TEAM CODES + BOTH SCORES, unordered, after the team crosswalk and exhibition-squad exclusion. Nothing was imputed and no near-match tolerance was used.
cross_family_reconciliation.interpretation: Two independently-sourced upstreams agree on every matched final score with ZERO disagreements. The 6 ESPN-only and 2 official-only games are the exact rows that must remain PROVISIONAL under the v2 official-plus-one rule; they are not evidence of a defect in either feed and must not be force-matched.
cross_family_reconciliation.date_shift_hypothesis_tested_and_rejecte: A +/-1 day tolerance recovered 0 additional games (0.0%), so the residual is NOT an ET/UTC date-label problem. It is genuine coverage difference.

team_crosswalk_findings.why_this_matters: A naive join on team abbreviation produces 0.00% score agreement. The families use different codes, and the first-pass mapping recovers only 82.82%. The full crosswalk recovers 99.71%.

SEASON_DEPENDENT_REVERSAL.finding: Phoenix reverses. Through 2024 ESPN uses PHX and the official feed uses PHO. In 2025 the two codes SWAP: ESPN uses PHO and the official feed uses PHX.
SEASON_DEPENDENT_REVERSAL.why_it_is_dangerous: A fixed PHX->PHO map is correct for 2017-2024 and silently WRONG for 2025. It does not fail loudly — it produces a self-consistent join to the wrong team, which is the orientation-flip failure mode already recorded in this repository on 2026-08-08. Arithmetic checks cannot catch it.
SEASON_DEPENDENT_REVERSAL.required: the crosswalk must be season-aware, and a post-join check must assert that each mapped team's season win-loss record reconciles against both feeds independently

team_crosswalk_findings.note_on_exclusions: These are All-Star and exhibition rosters (Team Wilson, Team Delle Donne, Team Stewart, Team Parker, Team Clark, Team Collier, USA national team). They are not franchises and must not enter a ratings model. They are excluded, not deleted — the staged bytes still contain them.

transport_independence.upstreams: ESPN endpoints and stats.wnba.com endpoints — genuinely independent observers, which is what makes the 99.71% agreement meaningful
transport_independence.shared_transport: both mirrors are maintained by sportsdataverse. A schema-mapping or team-ID join defect introduced in the TRANSPORT would hit both families identically and this reconciliation would not detect it.
transport_independence.residual_check_still_owed: spot-check a sample of finals directly against wnba.com before any row is granted FINAL status. Cross-feed agreement bounds upstream error, not mirror error.

still_absent.injuries: NO historical official injury archive exists in either repository. The INPUT_CONTRACT's injuries role cannot be filled for 2017-2025 from these sources. v0.2 excluding historical injuries is consistent with the contract only because v0.2 carries no injury feature; a live forecast still requires a current timestamped official two-team snapshot no more than 36h old, and postgame minutes may never be used to reconstruct pregame availability.
still_absent.consequence: WNBA remains DATA_BLOCKED for anything requiring pregame availability history. Results, boxes and minutes are no longer blocked.
